top_choice_rationale: P002 recognises induced-proximity degradation as a designable chemical reaction: Crews and Deshaies conceived heterobifunctional degraders, and Handa's identification of cereblon is the decisive measured experiment explaining why thalidomide-type glue drugs work in patients. The principle is independently reproduced, supported by ternary-complex structures and cooperativity data, and clinically demonstrated through the approved glue drugs. P001 is my close second (same concept core plus Liu), then Liu-alone base editing, which has the cleanest attribution though the Nishida and Kondo priority question is unresolved.
